articles.title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
articles.snippet: The trading platform’s gross crypto revenue fell to $1.35 billion in the second quarter. It also agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

articles.title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large
articles.snippet: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.

articles.title: Crypto-friendly bank Erebor in talks to raise $1.5 billion at $9.5 billion valuation: FT
articles.snippet: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.

articles.title: Pokémon cards are becoming multibillion dollar market. Crypto wants to fix how they trade
articles.snippet: Collectors are spending millions on trading cards, while blockchain startups are turning physical Pokémon cards into digital assets. The harder task is creating enough liquidity to compete with established marketplaces.

articles.title: MoneyGram expands on Solana with global crypto-to-cash service
articles.snippet: Wallets and apps on Solana can now tap MoneyGram's global network to move between digital assets and local currencies.
